privacy.en:
Effective October 7, 2026. CueLadder 1.0 · Hailink Labs.

Local practice data

Pieces, landmarks, self-ratings, notes, hint images, drafts and history stay locally on your device. No app account, product server, ads, analytics, tracking, microphone, automatic listening, MIDI, AI scoring or automatic cloud sync is used. Hailink Labs does not receive your practice library.

Images and files

The system picker supplies only images you select. CueLadder copies resized JPEGs and removes original private metadata; no broad photo access is requested. You choose export, backup and sharing destinations, which process files under their own policies. Device backups may contain app data according to your settings. Full backups contain readable practice data and images; protect them before sharing.

Apple purchases

Apple handles non-consumable Lifetime purchases and restoration through StoreKit. CueLadder verifies transactions to unlock multiple active pieces and does not receive payment card details. Practice backups cannot grant purchase access.

Retention and deletion

Recently Deleted retains pieces for 30 days. Permanent deletion removes current records; separate backups may retain copies. Delete All Local Data clears app-owned records, images, drafts, snapshots and exports. Copies saved outside the app require separate deletion. Local snapshots cannot protect against device loss or uninstalling. Save important full backups outside the app.
privacy.zh-CN:
生效日期：2026年10月7日。CueLadder 1.0 · Hailink Labs。

本地练习资料

曲目、路标、自评、备注、提示图片、草稿和历史保存在设备本地。无账号、产品服务器、广告、分析、追踪、麦克风、自动听音、MIDI、AI 评分或自动云同步。Hailink Labs 不接收练习资料。

图片与文件

系统选择器仅提供选定图片；App 复制缩小 JPEG 并移除原始私有元数据，不请求完整照片库权限。导出、备份和分享位置由你选择，接收方按自身政策处理。系统备份可能按设备设置包含 App 数据。完整备份含可读取的练习资料与图片，分享前请保护隐私。

Apple 购买

Apple 通过 StoreKit 处理非消耗型 Lifetime 及恢复购买。App 验证交易以解锁多首活跃曲目，不接收支付卡资料；练习备份不能授予权益。

保留与删除

最近删除保留30天。永久删除当前记录后，独立备份可能仍保留副本。删除全部本地数据清除 App 管理的记录、图片、草稿、快照及导出；App 外副本需另行删除。本地快照不能防止设备丢失或卸载，请将重要完整备份保存在 App 外。

support.en:
Start and check

Create your own piece and at least three landmarks using your edition's bar numbers. Bar 0 supports a pickup. Open the piece and Start Check. Rate first unaided starts honestly. A revealed hint turns a clean rating into Assisted; skipped or interrupted landmarks remain untested.

Practice and recover

Review clean/tested/planned counts, then Practice Weak Spots. Forward Recovery starts at the nearest later landmark and never wraps. Practice and recovery do not overwrite the Check. History preserves versions and explicit corrections. CueLadder does not listen, grade notes or certify readiness; you assess your playing.

Backups and recovery

Settings exports four CSV files or a complete .cueladderbackup with images and history. CSV is not a full backup. Restore validates the full backup, previews replacement and creates a pre-restore copy before replacing your library; it does not merge. Save important backups outside the app. Retry saving errors before continuing; do not uninstall when recovering unreadable local data.

Lifetime

One active piece includes all training, history, export and backup for free. Archive your current piece to activate another while retaining history. Lifetime unlocks multiple active pieces with a one-time non-consumable purchase, US reference $14.99. No subscription, timed trial or Family Sharing. Apple displays the current applicable price. Restore Purchases restores access through your Apple Account; Restore Backup restores practice data.

Help

Include the app version, action and exact error. Do not send private scores or backups unless you choose to share them. Respect copyright when choosing images.
support.zh-CN:
建立曲目并检查

创建自己的曲目，按所用谱本小节编号添加至少三个路标，弱起可用第0小节。打开曲目并 Start Check，诚实自评首次无提示起奏。揭示提示后 Clean 变为 Assisted；跳过或中断仍属未测。

练习与恢复

查看 clean/tested/planned 后进入 Practice Weak Spots。Forward Recovery 选择最近的后续路标，不绕回开头。练习和恢复不覆盖 Check；历史保留版本与显式修订。App 不听音、不评分或认证能力，由你自评。

备份与恢复

Settings 可导出四个 CSV 或含图片与历史的完整备份，CSV 不是完整备份。整库恢复先校验、预览并建立恢复前副本，再替换资料，不合并。重要备份请保存在 App 外；保存错误先重试，修复损坏数据时不要卸载。

Lifetime

一首活跃曲目包含全部训练、历史、导出与备份，永久免费。归档当前曲目后可启用下一首并保留历史。Lifetime 一次性非消耗型购买解锁多首活跃曲目，美国参考价 US$14.99，无订阅、限时试用或家庭共享；以 Apple 当前显示价格为准。Restore Purchases 恢复权益，Restore Backup 恢复练习资料。

帮助

提供版本、操作与准确错误；除非主动分享，不要发送私人乐谱或备份。图片须尊重版权。
